value.rationale: Products of composition operators and adjoints are the direct object of a 2026 Schatten-ideal paper. For all unequal degree pairs, the complete arithmetic classification yields a nontrivial three-way reversal in point spectra and strong-power behavior, while the entire unit disk remains the universal Fredholm spectrum with an exact full matrix-polynomial essential norm formula. This determines intrinsic operator dynamics and exact Calkin norms in a natural two-parameter family rather than a specially selected finite numerical invariant.
